mapper.select: SELECT t1.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.CY_GB AS cyGb , t1.balh_co AS balhCo , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , t1.jg_tr_co_cd AS jgTrCoCd , t1.jg_tr_co_nm AS jgTrCoNm , t1.START_YMD AS startYmd , t1.END_YMD AS endYmd , t1.SJ_YMD AS sjYmd , t1.NABIB_YMD AS nabibYmd , t1.cy_jm_cd AS cyJmCd , t1.sj_jm_cd AS sjJmCd , t1.susu_per AS susuPer , F_JM_NM (NVL(#{corpGr}, '2200'), t1.cy_jm_cd) AS xx_cy_jm_cd , F_JM_NM (NVL(#{corpGr}, '2200'), t1.sj_jm_cd) AS xx_sj_jm_cd FROM SJG1JC t1 WHERE (#{corpGr} IS NULL OR t1.ymd >= (SELECT ADD_MONTHS(h1.hyun_ymd, -3) FROM SZX0AA h1 WHERE h1.corp_gr = #{corpGr})) ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC, t1.JM_NM ASC, t1.balh_co ASC

SELECT tr.corp_gr AS corpGr , tr.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , tr.jg_tr_co_cd AS jgTrCoCd , tr.sc_YMD AS scYmd , tr.sc_JUSU AS scJusu , tr.sc_DANGA AS scDanga , tr.sc_AEK AS scAek , tr.sc_USER AS scUser , tr.cy_YMD AS cyYmd , tr.cy_JUSU AS cyJusu , tr.cy_DANGA AS cyDanga , tr.cy_AEK AS cyAek , tr.cy_JKM AS cyJkm , tr.cy_USER AS cyUser , tr.lock_end AS lockEnd , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.balh_co AS balhCo , t1.jg_tr_co_cd AS sjg1jcJgTrCoCd , t1.jg_tr_co_nm AS sjg1jcJgTrCoNm , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , F_BALH_NM (NVL(tr.corp_gr, #{corpGr}), t1.balh_co) AS xx_balh_co , t1.cy_GB AS cyGb , t1.sj_ymd AS sjYmd , t1.sj_jm_cd AS JmCd , t1.start_ymd AS startYmd , t1.end_ymd AS endYmd FROM SJG1JC t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN sjg1jc_tr tr ON tr.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND tr.JC_JOIN = t1.JC_JOIN WHERE t1.balh_co IS NOT NULL AND (#{corpGr} IS NULL OR t1.nabib_ymd >= (SELECT ADD_MONTHS(h1.hyun_ymd, -1) FROM SZX0AA h1 WHERE h1.corp_gr = #{corpGr}) OR tr.jc_join IS NOT NULL) order by t1.ymd desc, t1.jm_nm, t1.sj_jm_cd

SELECT t1.af_gyul_ymd AS gyulYmd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS titleYmd FROM SZM0GI t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.af_gyul_ymd Between trunc(now (),'mm') And LAST_DAY(now ()) AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ORDER BY t1.af_gyul_ymd ASC, t1.fund_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT cj.jm_cd AS jmCd , cj.cj_nm AS cjNm , ia.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , ig.af_ija_ymd AS afIjaYmd , CASE WHEN ig.af_ija_ymd = cj.sanghw_ymd THEN 'red' ELSE 'blue' END AS lineColor FROM SCM0CM t1 , SCJ0IG ig , SCM0CJ cj , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = F_OPEN_YMD(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD'), '-') AND ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ig.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND ig.af_ija_ymd BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND cj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT hj.jm_cd AS jmCd , hj.hj_nm AS cjNm , ia.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , ig.af_ija_ymd AS afIjaYmd , CASE WHEN ig.af_ija_ymd = hj.sanghw_ymd THEN 'red' ELSE 'blue' END AS lineColor FROM SHM0HM t1 , SHJ0IG ig , SHM0HJ hj , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = F_OPEN_YMD(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD'), '-') AND ig.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ig.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND ig.af_ija_ymd BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND hj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND hj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT la.sys_id AS sysId , la.board_no AS boardNo , la.docu_no AS docuNo , la.docu_title AS docuTitle , la.tree_level AS treeLevel , la.start_dtm AS startDtm , la.end_dtm AS endDtm , la.memb_type AS membType , la.role_no AS roleNo , la.hold_yn AS holdYn , la.ontop_yn AS ontopYn , la.writer_name AS writerName , la.linked_pgm_no AS linkedPgmNo , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fw_docu_log ta WHERE ta.sys_id = la.sys_id AND ta.board_no = la.board_no AND ta.docu_no = la.docu_no AND ta.read_user = #{userId}) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS readYn FROM fw_docu_mst la ORDER BY la.docu_no DESC

SELECT 'Y' AS chtYn , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'MM') || '월 ' || TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'W') || '주' AS cv2Chtnm , NVL(t1.g90104, 0) / 100000000 AS cv2Chtvalue001 , t1.fund1 AS cv2Chtvalue002 FROM fw_day_chtdata t1 WHERE (#{corpGr} IS NULL OR t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr}) AND t1.YMD Between ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(NVL(#{ymd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, -6) And TO_DATE(NVL(#{ymd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.FUND_CURRENCY = 'KRW' AND t1.weekday = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(#{ymd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'dy') ORDER BY t1.ymd ASC
